definitions.request_success: HTTP 200 with at least one returned recommendation card.
definitions.busy: HTTP 503 and the explicit Gemini temporarily-busy error message.
definitions.timeout: HTTP 503 and an explicit Gemini timeout message; separate from busy.
definitions.card_quality: Never inferred from request success or the app's own evidence checks.

latest_slide_claims.reason: No corresponding twelve-request records, exact card denominator, or final scoring/reviewer protocol was located in the inspected repository and local evaluation artifacts.
latest_slide_claims.new_rerun_policy: A future run must be reported with its own date, serving commit, model and protocol, using the measured results even when they differ from the slides.

limitations: This is a recomputation of historical response logs and recorded menu audits, not a new live run or a new source/venue review.
The evaluated application was build 37259485b5eff73143f71c72eb5917f6a8a2af52 on November 16, 2026; these metrics do not measure final commit 4be1cda19a19f2e4f893ff6ee6b75f945eb358c4.
Nine query cases were repeated across two rounds in four cities. Repeated queries and recommendation cards are not independent users or unique restaurants.
The config lists five supported cities, but the actual requests used only Philadelphia, Los Angeles, Chicago and New York.
The 22.2% error figure pools three Gemini busy messages and one Gemini timeout. Strict busy alone is 16.7%; these categories must not be conflated.
The existing card annotations are retained with source/evidence URLs. Reviewer independence, agreement and contemporaneous full-page snapshots are not established by this reconciliation.
Unresolved card verdicts are normalized to insufficient_evidence and count in the 26-card denominator; they do not count as passes.
Menus and venues may have changed since the original audit. No current menu freshness is asserted.
